components.name: File item
components.description: File item — one uploaded file inside Uploader · File or Drop zone. React: <FileItem status name meta onRemove onRetry />. Status: Uploading (Progress bar S, meta shows size · %), Done, Error (status/danger/soft row, reason in Meta, Retry link). Name truncates to one line. Type icon is exposed (swap per file type). Use inside Uploader; not a standalone list row.

components.name: Uploader · File
components.description: Uploader · File — a button that opens the file picker, plus the list of chosen files. React: <FileUploader state size accept maxSize multiple />. Size M uses Button L (36), Size L uses Button XL (44). Button is exposed: change its label and icon from the panel. Files are File item instances (Uploading · Done · Error). Put it inside a Fieldset: the label, format/size limit (Helper) and error

components.name: Uploader · Media
components.description: Uploader · Media — one photo or video tile. React: <MediaUploader kind state size coverBadge />. Kind: Photo · Video. Size: S 80 · M 104 · L 128 (scale/*). Empty shows the add icon and label; Hover adds fill/soft-hover; Focus uses _Focus ring; Loading shows bg/overlay + spinner + percent over the picture; Filled shows the picture with a Remove button (Normal-contrast) and optional Cover badg

components.description: Uploader · Drop zone — Web drag-and-drop area with a browse link. React: <DropZone state accept maxSize multiple hint />. Dashed border is a documented exception to the border-free rule (1.7 Border): the dashed line is what tells people this is a drop target.
